description: This file contains an Android activity class 'MediaPlayerDemo_Video' that demonstrates video playback using the MediaPlayer API. It manages media source setup, surface creation, playback controls, and event handling for video playback scenarios.

classes.name: MediaPlayerDemo_Video
classes.description: Android activity class demonstrating video playback with MediaPlayer, handling surface lifecycle, media source setup, and playback controls.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up surface callbacks, and prepares UI components.

methods.name: playVideo
methods.description: Configures and prepares the MediaPlayer with either local or streaming video sources based on input.

methods.name: onBufferingUpdate
methods.description: Handles buffering status updates during media playback.

methods.name: onCompletion
methods.description: Handles actions upon media playback completion.

methods.name: onVideoSizeChanged
methods.description: Responds to changes in video size, adjusting the display accordingly.

methods.name: onPrepared
methods.description: Callback when media is ready to play, triggers playback if conditions are met.

methods.name: surfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles surface dimension or format changes.

methods.name: surfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the display surface is destroyed.

methods.name: surfaceCreated
methods.description: Triggered when the surface for video display is created; initiates video playback.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Releases media resources when activity is paused.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Releases media resources when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: doCleanUp
methods.description: Resets internal state variables for playback.

methods.name: startVideoPlayback
methods.description: Adjusts surface size and commences media playback.
